algorithm.name: BTI-WorstGroupGuard-HCP
algorithm.between_group_rule: ceil((m+1)*0.95)-th order statistic of group-tail thresholds
algorithm.outer_lobo_specialization: with m=35, use max of 35 training group-tail thresholds
algorithm.deployment_features: frozen HPR prediction and frozen A4 scale only

validation.protocol: 36-background outer LOBO; heldout background excluded from both within-group tails and between-group qhat

theory.hierarchical_conformal_reference: Lee, Barber and Willett, Distribution-free inference with hierarchical data, 2023
theory.two_layer_reference: Dunn, Wasserman and Ramdas, Distribution-Free Prediction Sets for Two-Layer Hierarchical Models
theory.claim_scope: finite-sample rank guarantee for an exchangeable new group-tail threshold; not arbitrary-shift conditional coverage

stop_rule: If the preregistered Development gates fail, stop adding HCP variants and do not access Confirmatory data.

forbidden_data.scope: all historical and current confirmatory test scenes, predictions, metrics and labels
